thread:
pagerbot: Paging: High-volume 401/403 spike from 34.87.12.0/24 to auth-proxy /v1/token (rate ~12k/min) — possible credential-spray or exfil attempt. Auto-alert: anomalies > 3x baseline.

maria-oncall: on it. I'm taking initial triage. tagging @akash-sec and @jayden-eng. Any evidence of customer API calls affected?

jayden-eng: seeing lots of 401s, retries, and a handful of 500s from proxy. No clear customer error spikes in product metrics yet but some increased latency on auth path.

akash-sec: get me full proxy logs and headers for 4102345678 window. check for leaked auth headers in logs. start a quick search: `jq '.requests[] | select(.src_ip=="34.87.*")' /var/log/proxy/*.json`

maria-oncall: spinning up grep on archival logs now. copying hits to s3://redwood-incident-logs/4102345678/proxy-raw.gz — will preserve original files for forensics.

liz-cs: heads-up: one customer (acme-inc) reported intermittent authentication errors on a support ticket 10m ago. I'm flagging potential customer impact.

jayden-eng: adding temporary rate limit rule at edge for that /v1/token route to reduce noise. Command I applied: `curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/ratelimit -d '{"route":"/v1/token","limit":200}'` — will revert once stable. :white_check_mark:

maria-oncall: good. also applying IP block for 34.87.12.0/24 at edge WAF for now (non-destructive blocking). @ops-rotation can you confirm firewall rule propagated?

ops-rotation: confirmed — WAF rule `block-4102345678-auth-probe` applied across regions, prop time ~18s. traffic from that /24 dropped to near zero now.

akash-sec: initial log scan: found several requests with Authorization header fragments in debug logs forwarded to our analytics indexer. Possible leakage path. Need to rotate any tokens that might have been exposed and quarantine the indexer snapshot.

jayden-eng: which indexer? I see `analytics-proxy-forwarder` shipping to ES cluster `obs-index-1`. I'll pause the forwarder and snapshot the target: `POST /_snapshot/incident-4102345678` then pause ingestion.

maria-oncall: pausing forwarder now. pausing config: `servicectl stop analytics-forwarder --grace 30s` — stopped. snapshot started.

liz-cs: prepping customer comms draft in case token rotation triggers client disruptions. will coordinate with legal.

sara-legal: standing by. if user PII or tokens were present we need to follow the incident disclosure playbook. collect scope (how many tokens, which customers) before comms.

akash-sec: quick checks: 1) determine whether the leaked fragments are full bearer tokens or partials; 2) list token IDs associated with those headers; 3) begin targeted rotation of any service tokens seen. I'm running `grep -E "Authorization: Bearer [A-Za-z0-9_.-]{20,}"` against preserved logs.

jayden-eng: found 3 full bearer tokens in the archived logs with `auth.service` scope. Initiating rotate for those service tokens now via the keystore rotation endpoint: `POST /internal/keystore/rotate?id=svc-23,svc-77,svc-91` — kicked off, will validate.

maria-oncall: ops — please ensure KMS audit entries are preserved and exporters disabled for this incident.

ops-rotation: KMS audits retained. Disabled log exporter to external partner bucket while we investigate.

devex-support: any impact on hosted API users from rotating these service tokens? might cause brief 401s for background jobs.

jayden-eng: rotation applied with canary rollout to non-customer critical pools first. we should see minimal impact. Monitoring for errors.

liz-cs: notifying affected customer contacts on a hold message: "We're investigating elevated auth traffic; we may rotate tokens and will provide updates if your integrations are affected."

sara-legal: keep me in the loop on scope. if tokens map to customer accounts we need the incident severity assessment ASAP.

akash-sec: forensics note — please preserve the indexer snapshot and a copy of the paused forwarder config. Also capture `tcpdump` of the proxy interface for future replay.

maria-oncall: taking tcpdump (pcap) now: `sudo tcpdump -w /tmp/4102345678.pcap host 34.87.12.0/24` — will upload to s3 after collection.

pagerbot: Update: WAF rule active, rate limiting applied, forwarder paused, 3 service tokens rotated.

jayden-eng: alert: a secondary source range 34.87.13.45 started retrying but hit the block — adding to blocklist to be safe.

maria-oncall: requesting sec review for attacker infrastructure correlation: @akash-sec can you run passive DNS & geo checks?

akash-sec: running passive checks now. early signals point to VPS provider cloud-xyz; gathering WHOIS and ASN.

liz-cs: customer impact check: telemetry shows a <1% uptick in auth failures for ~8 customers, intermittent. we'll prepare targeted follow-up messages if we confirm token rotations cause any disruptions.

sara-legal: if any tokens belonged to customers with regulatory obligations, notify compliance immediately.

maria-oncall: next steps: 1) preserve artifacts (done), 2) continue token rotation and verify no active sessions remain, 3) scrub forwarded logs (coordinate with analytics), 4) schedule bridge with sec + SRE in 30m for deeper forensics.

akash-sec: initiating deeper scan for lateral movement — checking service-to-service traffic and abnormal IAM calls in last 24h.

jayden-eng: re-enabled normal rate for /v1/token (limit removed) — leaving WAF block in place for the /24s until we have IOC list to avoid accidental unblock.

devex-support: flagging internal runbook `INC-rotate-keys` and `INC-scrub-logs` for postmortem checklist.

maria-oncall: creating incident ticket INC-2026-4102345678 and assigning owners: triage=SRE, forensics=security, comms=CS+legal.

pagerbot: Reminder: on-call handoff in 29m for ops-rotation; if case persists escalate to senior SRE pager.

ops-rotation: noted. will stay on bridge until handoff. leaving WAF blocks and snapshots in place.

akash-sec: evidence summary so far: unauthorized IPs attempted credential-spray, some debug logs forwarded contained 3 full service bearer tokens -> rotated, possible partial tokens in analytics index -> snapshot created and will be sanitized. No confirmed customer data exfil observed yet.

liz-cs: prepping a proactive customer email template requesting they rotate any customer-managed tokens if they see issues; we'll only send after legal approves.

sara-legal: approved draft to review in 12m. hold on public notice until scope confirmed.

maria-oncall: bridging with @akash-sec and @jayden-eng in 30m for root-cause deeper dive. Will update ticket with timeline and actions.

pagerbot: Incident status: mitigation in place, artifacts preserved, rotations performed, customer comms pending. Next update in 30m or sooner if material changes. :lock:

ops-rotation: leaving final note: ensure all rotated tokens are marked `revoked=true` in keystore and update rotation runbook with IOC ranges for cleanup.

maria-oncall: thanks team. if anyone finds additional leaked headers or index entries ping here. moving to monitoring phase.

liz-cs: once we have final scope I'll coordinate with affected customers for closure and remediation steps.

akash-sec: will follow up with a forensic report and IOC list within the bridge.

jayden-eng: logging this thread into the postmortem tracker. good work. :thumbsup:
